title.en: Rural 17 kW pump or Diesel 30 when power is absent?
title.zh: 没有电源时，选 17 kW 农村泵还是柴油30？

description.en: 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal is the house pump. Diesel 30 is 56 kW, 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m at 2000 kg.
description.zh: 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m 是住宅泵。柴油30是 56 kW、15 m³/h、60 m / 180 m、2000 kg。

h1.en: Rural 17 kW pump or Diesel 30 when power is absent?
h1.zh: 没有电源时，选 17 kW 农村泵还是柴油30？

directAnswer.en: Start with the 17 kW rural diesel if the line is inside 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical and 5–8 m³/h. Move to Diesel 30 when the off-grid job needs 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without stable grid power. The house pump is 800 kg with aggregate 1–3 cm. Diesel 30 is 2000 kg, with a 3 cm maximum cell and a 1 cm note in the introduction.
directAnswer.zh: 管路在水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、5–8 m³/h 内，从 17 kW 农村柴油泵开始。无电网作业需要 15 m³/h 和 60 m / 180 m 时，再看柴油30。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都印给电网不便的工地。住宅泵是 800 kg，骨料 1–3 cm。柴油30是 2000 kg，最大骨料格 3 cm，产品介绍里还有 1 cm 的说明。

heading.en: Names are part of the choice
heading.zh: 名称就是选择的一部分

body.en: One product is called the rural self-built house diesel pump. The other is Diesel 30, a trailer for rural and infrastructure placement. Buying the trailer for a line that fits the house pump adds weight and a different distance table you may not need.
body.zh: 一台的产品名就是农村自建房柴油混凝土泵。另一台是柴油30，用于农村与基建的拖泵。管路对得上住宅泵时去买拖泵，会多出重量和一张你可能不需要的距离表。

heading.en: Electric 15 remains the grid alternative at this size
heading.zh: 这一档有电网时的替代仍是电动15

body.en: If a 15 kW supply exists, Electric 15 prints the longer 60–80 m horizontal and 15–20 m vertical at 450 kg. Absence of that supply is why the 17 kW diesel exists. Presence of that supply is why you should not stay on diesel out of habit.
body.zh: 如果有 15 kW 电源，电动15印了更长的水平 60–80 m 和垂直 15–20 m，重量 450 kg。没有这路电源，才有 17 kW 柴油泵。有这路电源时，不要习惯性留在柴油上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say which distance pair you measured: 30–50 m or 60 m / 180 m. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明你量到的是哪一对距离：30–50 m，还是 60 m / 180 m。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: The rural pump prints 0.2 m³. Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³.
answer.zh: 农村泵印 0.2 m³。柴油30印 0.3 m³。

answer.en: The rural pump prints 15 MPa. Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa.
answer.zh: 农村泵印 15 MPa。柴油30印 20 MPa。

answer.en: No. The compact diesel page is the 17 kW rural pump. The trailer series published here starts at Diesel 30.
answer.zh: 没有。紧凑柴油页是 17 kW 农村泵。这里公布的拖式系列从柴油30开始。
